title.en: Why Amazon Won — The Three-Engine Machine
title.zh-cn: 亚马逊为什么赢 —— 购物、订阅、云的三重引擎
title.fr: Pourquoi Amazon gagne — la machine à trois moteurs

caption.ko: 시총 2.83조 달러, 나스닥 6위. 아마존의 성공 공식을 9장면으로 뜯어봤다.
caption.en: 2.83 trillion dollars in market cap, sixth on the Nasdaq. Amazon's success formula in 9 scenes.
caption.zh-cn: 市值2.83万亿美元，纳斯达克第六。用9个画面拆解亚马逊的成功公式。
caption.fr: 2 830 milliards de dollars de capitalisation, sixième du Nasdaq. La formule Amazon en 9 scènes.

en: A shopping site worth 2.83 trillion dollars.
zh-cn: 一家购物网站，市值2.83万亿美元。
亚马逊是怎么走到今天的？
fr: Un site de shopping à 2 830 milliards de dollars.
Comment Amazon en est-il arrivé là ?

moral.ko: 성공은 한 번의 판매가 아니라 서로를 키우는 구조에서 나온다.
moral.en: Success comes not from one sale, but from a structure that feeds itself.
moral.zh-cn: 成功不来自一次成交，而来自互相喂养的结构。
moral.fr: Le succès ne vient pas d'une vente, mais d'une structure qui se nourrit elle-même.

cta.ko: 오늘 아마존의 부문별 매출 비중을 직접 찾아봐라.
cta.en: Go look up Amazon's revenue split by segment today.
cta.zh-cn: 今天就去查亚马逊各分部的营收占比。
cta.fr: Cherchez dès aujourd'hui la répartition du chiffre d'affaires d'Amazon par segment.

narration.ko: 오늘 다룰 회사는 아마존이다. 티커는 AMZN, 나스닥에서 시총 6위에 올라 있는 회사다.
narration.en: Today's company is Amazon. Ticker AMZN, and it sits at number six on the Nasdaq by market cap.
narration.zh-cn: 今天讲的是亚马逊。代码AMZN，市值排在纳斯达克第六。
narration.fr: La société du jour, c'est Amazon. Ticker AMZN, sixième capitalisation du Nasdaq.

scenes.image_prompt: black and white pencil drawing, monochrome, graphite sketch, hand-drawn line art, no color, no border, no frame, no text, corporate headquarters building exterior

narration.ko: 시총은 2.83조 달러다. 나스닥 전체 6위, 현재 주가는 262.43달러. 3년 동안 주가는 80% 올랐다.
narration.en: Market cap is 2.83 trillion dollars, sixth on the Nasdaq. The stock trades at 262.43 dollars, up 80% over three years.
narration.zh-cn: 市值2.83万亿美元，纳斯达克第六。股价262.43美元，三年上涨80%。
narration.fr: 2 830 milliards de dollars de capitalisation, sixième du Nasdaq. L'action vaut 262,43 dollars, en hausse de 80% sur trois ans.

scenes.image_prompt: black and white pencil drawing, monochrome, graphite sketch, hand-drawn line art, no color, no border, no frame, no text, aerial view city skyline skyscrapers

narration.ko: 아마존이 파는 것은 세 가지다. 온라인 쇼핑몰과 클라우드 사업, 그리고 Prime 구독이다. 이 셋이 회사의 뼈대다.
narration.en: Amazon sells three things. An online store, a cloud business, and a Prime subscription. Those three are the skeleton of the company.
narration.zh-cn: 亚马逊卖三样东西。线上商城、云计算，还有Prime订阅。这三样就是公司的骨架。
narration.fr: Amazon vend trois choses. Une boutique en ligne, le cloud, et l'abonnement Prime. Ces trois-là forment la structure.

scenes.image_prompt: black and white pencil drawing, monochrome, graphite sketch, hand-drawn line art, no color, no border, no frame, no text, modern factory production line

narration.ko: Prime 구독이 반복 소비를 만들었다. 배송과 콘텐츠를 묶어 고객을 붙잡았고, 그 반복이 매출을 키웠다.
narration.en: Prime turned one purchase into a habit. Bundling shipping and content locked customers in, and that repetition built the revenue.
narration.zh-cn: Prime把一次性购买变成了习惯。配送和内容绑在一起锁住用户，重复消费撑起营收。
narration.fr: Prime a transformé l'achat en habitude. Livraison et contenus retiennent le client, et cette répétition fait le chiffre d'affaires.

scenes.image_prompt: black and white pencil drawing, monochrome, graphite sketch, hand-drawn line art, no color, no border, no frame, no text, retail store customers shopping

narration.ko: 성장이 멈춘 것처럼 보인 구간도 있었다. 3년 +80%라는 숫자 안에도 흔들린 시간이 들어 있다.
narration.en: There were stretches when growth looked stalled. Inside that 80% gain sit years of doubt.
narration.zh-cn: 也有过看起来停滞的阶段。那80%的涨幅里，藏着怀疑的年份。
narration.fr: Il y a eu des périodes où la croissance semblait à l'arrêt. Dans ces 80%, il y a des années de doute.

scenes.image_prompt: black and white pencil drawing, monochrome, graphite sketch, hand-drawn line art, no color, no border, no frame, no text, empty industrial warehouse interior

narration.ko: 전환점은 클라우드였다. AWS가 이익을 만들고, 그 이익이 다시 소매와 물류를 지탱했다.
narration.en: The turning point was the cloud. AWS generated the profit, and that profit carried retail and logistics.
narration.zh-cn: 转折点是云。AWS赚钱，利润再反哺零售和物流。
narration.fr: Le tournant, c'est le cloud. AWS génère le profit, et ce profit porte le commerce et la logistique.

scenes.image_prompt: black and white pencil drawing, monochrome, graphite sketch, hand-drawn line art, no color, no border, no frame, no text, server room data center corridor

narration.ko: 쇼핑이 구독을 부르고, 구독이 소비를 늘린다. 그 규모가 다시 클라우드 투자를 감당하는 구조다.
narration.en: Shopping feeds the subscription, the subscription feeds more spending. That scale pays for the cloud in turn.
narration.zh-cn: 购物带来订阅，订阅带来更多消费。规模又养得起云。
narration.fr: Le commerce nourrit l'abonnement, l'abonnement nourrit la dépense. Cette échelle finance le cloud.

scenes.image_prompt: black and white pencil drawing, monochrome, graphite sketch, hand-drawn line art, no color, no border, no frame, no text, network cables connection technology

narration.ko: 교훈은 하나다. 한 개의 사업이 아니라, 서로를 키우는 여러 개의 엔진을 만들어라.
narration.en: One lesson. Build several engines that feed each other, not a single business.
narration.zh-cn: 教训只有一个。不要只做一个生意，要做互相喂养的多个引擎。
narration.fr: Une leçon. Bâtissez plusieurs moteurs qui se nourrissent l'un l'autre, pas une seule activité.

scenes.image_prompt: black and white pencil drawing, monochrome, graphite sketch, hand-drawn line art, no color, no border, no frame, no text, old notebook handwritten planning desk

narration.ko: 오늘 아마존의 부문별 매출 비중을 직접 찾아봐라. 숫자가 이 구조를 그대로 증명한다.
narration.en: Go find Amazon's revenue split by segment today. The numbers prove this structure on their own.
narration.zh-cn: 今天就去查亚马逊各分部的营收占比。数字会直接证明这个结构。
narration.fr: Cherchez aujourd'hui la répartition du chiffre d'affaires d'Amazon par segment. Les chiffres prouvent la structure.
